islamicFacts: Kalendar Hijira ta fara ne daga hijirar Annabi ﷺ daga Makka zuwa Madina.
Ramadan shine watan tara a kalendar Hijira.
Watanni masu alfarma sune: Dhu al-Qi'dah, Dhu al-Hijjah, Muharram, da Rajab.
Daren Laylatul Qadr ya fi watanni dubu alheri, kuma ana nemansa a goman karshe na Ramadan.
Ranar Juma'a ita ce rana mafi kyau a mako ga Musulmai.
Azumin ranar Arafah yana kankare zunubin shekara biyu, da ikon Allah, ga wanda ba alhaji ba.
Ranar Ashura rana ce mai albarka, kuma ana so a yi azumi a cikinta.
Zakka, Azumi, da Aikin Hajji suna da nasaba da kalendar Hijira.
Ganin jinjirin wata Sunnah ce da ke da alaƙa da farkon watannin Hijira.
Ana gane ranakun bukukuwan Musulunci ta kalendar Hijira, ba kalendar Miladiyya ba.

1-10.title: Ranar Ashura
1-10.desc: Ranar da aka fi so a yi azumi mai cike da lada mai yawa.

3-12.title: Mawlidi
3-12.desc: Ranar haihuwar Annabi ﷺ bisa ga fitattun kwanan wata.

7-27.title: Isra'i da Mi'iraji
7-27.desc: Dare mai albarka mai nasaba da Tafiyar Dare da Mi'iraji.

8-15.title: Nisfu Sha'aban
8-15.desc: Dare mai albarka wanda Musulmai da yawa ke raya shi.

9-27.title: Laylatul Qadr (Hasashe)
9-27.desc: Daya daga cikin darare mafi girma, ana nemansa a goman karshe.

10-1.title: Karamar Sallah (Eid al-Fitr)
10-1.desc: Ranar farin ciki ga Musulmai bayan kammala azumin Ramadan.

12-9.title: Ranar Arafah
12-9.desc: Daya daga cikin ranaku mafi kyau a shekara, ana son azumi ga wanda ba Alhaji ba.

12-10.title: Babbar Sallah (Eid al-Adha)
12-10.desc: Ranar Layya kuma daya daga cikin ranaku mafi girma ga Musulmai.

1-10.title: Bayani na Musulunci
1-10.desc: Ana so a yi azumin Ashura, sannan a hada da rana daya kafin ko bayan shi.

9-1.title: Bayani na Musulunci
9-1.desc: Ramadan watan azumi ne, sallolin dare, da karatun Alkur'ani.

9-27.title: Bayani na Musulunci
9-27.desc: Ana neman Laylatul Qadr a goman karshe; tafi watanni 1000 alheri.

10-1.title: Bayani na Musulunci
10-1.desc: Ranar Sallah rana ce ta murna da godiya, nuna farin ciki Sunnah ce.

12-9.title: Bayani na Musulunci
12-9.desc: Azumin Arafah ga wanda ba alhaji ba yana kankare zunubin shekara biyu.

12-10.title: Bayani na Musulunci
12-10.desc: Babbar Sallah rana ce mai girma da aka shar'anta yin layya a cikinta.
